projects.title: DriftSense
projects.what: Finds where a wafer-inspection microscope actually is — under unknown 8–12× zoom and ±5° rotation — or says the pattern isn’t there.
projects.proof: match F1 0.91 on 2,250 pairs · CAD-to-SEM within 1 px on 600

projects.title: VehicleGPT
projects.what: Ask a car about its own data: a small LLM answering from CAN logs, fully offline.
projects.proof: hybrid 29.5% → 95.5% on 200 q · best single model 82% @ 1.74 s, 2 cores / 2 GiB

projects.title: Mouna
projects.what: Speak by mouthing words — silent lip-reading turned into voice on a phone NPU, no internet.

projects.title: DT Guardian
projects.what: Simulated edge controller for a 200 kVA transformer: MILP scheduling of battery, EV charging and pump loads.
projects.proof: energy not served, 6 h outage: 121.2 → 56.7 kWh (−53%)

building.title: Rakshak-Edge
building.what: Catches scam SMS and links on an Arm device, offline — and refuses explanations it can’t back up.
building.status: phase 1 due nov 2026 · Arm × Bharat AI-SoC · team lead

building.title: Interfacial Heat Transport Prediction
building.what: A model for how well heat crosses the boundary between two solids, which has to beat the standard mismatch models on interfaces it has never seen.
building.status: planning · benchmark first · Discovered Materials Grand Challenge

building.title: Low-Cost Axial-Flow Ventricular Assist Device
building.what: A cheap, magnetically coupled axial-flow blood pump with a see-through housing, so clots can be seen forming. A benchtop research prototype, built with a mechanical engineering student and a doctor as clinical advisor.
building.status: phase 0 · CAD + CFD · water and blood-analogue tests only

building.title: One-Pass Neural Network Repair
building.what: Can a small network look at a corrupted, pruned or forgetful model and predict the weight patch that fixes it, with no retraining?

building.title: Adaptive Recurrent Depth in Looped LLMs
building.what: Which questions an extra recurrent loop fixes, leaves alone or breaks in looped language models, and whether that can be predicted when the data shifts.
building.status: setup · Ouro-1.4B · GSM8K → MATH-500 / BBH / GPQA

building.title: LLM Quantization & Inference Lab
building.what: Hands-on quantization and serving experiments, starting with FP8 inference for a 27B Qwen model.

building.title: Axiom Trace
building.what: A tutor that knows what you know: knowledge-graph RAG with mastery tracking and animated ECE explanations.
building.status: personal project · solo · Next.js web + Kotlin app
